en.text: Laghu Vyavasay Yojana provides micro-finance up to five lakh rupees for small business initiatives.
Green Business Scheme supports eco-friendly enterprises and electric vehicles up to thirty lakh rupees.
Education Loan Scheme provides concessional loans up to twenty lakh rupees in India and forty lakh abroad.
Voctech Loan provides up to four lakh rupees for skill certification and trade toolkits.
Caste Certificate. Valid Scheduled Caste certificate issued by competent authority. Issuer: Tehsildar or Sub-Divisional Magistrate.
Family Income Certificate. Income proof showing family income is within five lakh rupees per year. Issuer: Revenue Officer or Tehsildar.
Aadhaar Card. Aadhaar linked to direct benefit transfer enabled bank account. Issuer: Unique Identification Authority of India.
Bank Passbook. Active bank account passbook or statement with account number and IFSC code. Issuer: Scheduled Commercial Bank or Regional Rural Bank.
Detailed Project Report. Bankable project profile with three year cash flow estimates. Issuer: Technical Consultant or Chartered Accountant.
Equipment Quotation. Official price quotation for machinery or equipment from GST registered supplier. Issuer: Authorized Equipment Supplier.
Admission Offer Letter. Confirmed admission proof from recognized university or institute. Issuer: Registrar of Recognized Institution.
Course Fee Schedule. Official tuition and living expense breakdown. Issuer: College Finance Office.
Educational Transcripts. Official marksheets of qualifying examinations. Issuer: Board or University.
Co-borrower KYC and Statements. Parent or guardian KYC documents and bank statement. Issuer: Bank.
Trade License or Registration. Commercial establishment registration or trade license. Issuer: Municipal Corporation.
Land Ownership or Lease Deed. Proof of project site ownership or registered lease agreement. Issuer: Sub-Registrar Office.
Udyam Registration Certificate. MSME registration certificate with enterprise details. Issuer: Ministry of MSME.
Green Technology Quotation. Price invoice for certified electric vehicles or solar equipment. Issuer: Certified Clean Tech Dealer.
Transport Permit or Commercial License. Commercial driving license or transport permit. Issuer: Regional Transport Office.
Electricity Bill and Site Feasibility. Sanctioned power bill and site feasibility for solar installation. Issuer: State Power DISCOM.
Business Activity Note. Applicant self declaration note describing proposed micro enterprise. Issuer: Applicant Self-Declaration.
Applicant Photo and SHG Proof. Passport photograph and Self Help Group membership proof. Issuer: Self Help Group.
Vocational Admission Proof. Skill training admission proof or NSQF level certificate. Issuer: Accredited Training Centre.
Trade Toolkit Quotation. Cost estimate for vocational toolkit and skill equipment. Issuer: Authorized Tool Supplier.
